metadata.case_name: CHAN HUNG HANG v. FAT KEE MARINE REPAIRING & ENGINEERING CO LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fracture of the tuft of distal phalanx of the RMF
source: X-ray showed fracture of the tuft of distal phalanx of the RMF.
He was found to have suffered crush injury to his RMF.
Physical examination revealed bruise and tenderness over the tip of the RMF and subungal haematoma over nail.

manifestations.description: pain in right middle finger (persisting on weather change, exertion and when pressed lightly)
bruise and tenderness over the tip of the right middle finger
decreased active range of motion of right middle finger (initially)
mild ulnar deviation of the distal interphalangeal joint
reduced pad-to-pad pinch grip of the right middle finger (2 kgf compared with left 5 kgf)
power grip right hand 41 kgf (left 42 kgf)
favouring the right middle finger in work causing reduced working speed/efficiency

treatments_received: attendance at Princess Margaret Hospital A&E
admission to orthopaedic ward and fitting of finger/thimble splint
occupational therapy (splint follow up, mobilisation programme) - 10 sessions
physiotherapy (ultrasound, wax therapy, desensitisation/mobilisation exercises) - 4 sessions

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities resulting from injury to the right middle finger (PSLA awarded)
Reduced earning capacity/handicap in the labour market due to reduced efficiency favouring the injured right middle finger (loss of earning capacity awarded)
